hunks.baseline: The Second and Third Elders pressed him as if they were a single body.

hunks.baseline: He had trained in exceptional martial arts and taken elixirs since he was a child, but this was a bad matchup. The First Elder was a vile old monster who had lived more than sixty years with his black heart hidden.
hunks.sol: He had trained in exceptional martial arts and taken elixirs since childhood, but his opponent was simply too formidable. The First Elder was a vile old monster who had lived more than sixty years while concealing his dark ambitions.

hunks.baseline: Together with the Head Elder, he was a living witness who had fought his way through the Great Faction War.
hunks.sol: Alongside the Head Elder, he was a living witness to the Great Faction War, having fought his way through it with his own two hands.

hunks.baseline: “You damn old bastard.”
hunks.sol: “You damned old bastard.”

hunks.sol: The First Elder chuckled.

hunks.baseline: But the First Elder was not nearly as comfortable as he looked.
hunks.sol: But the First Elder was not nearly as comfortable as he appeared.

hunks.baseline: Or perhaps an old man’s pride had made him overrate himself.

hunks.baseline: Sixty years. He had accumulated profound internal energy, but even that could not stop his body from aging.
hunks.sol: Sixty years. He had accumulated profound internal energy, but even that could not halt the aging of his body.

hunks.baseline: After a bitter jab at himself, the First Elder stepped toward Jin Wikyung.
hunks.sol: With a bitter, self-mocking smile, the First Elder advanced on Jin Wikyung.

hunks.baseline: The swords of his sworn younger brothers, the Second and Third Elders, grew even fiercer.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung and Wipeng began to be pushed back. They had just fought the Peak masters of the Mount Heng Sword Sect, and that made it worse.

hunks.baseline: Their vision swam. Small wounds multiplied across their bodies. Their hands and feet no longer moved as they wanted.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s face darkened.

hunks.baseline: The First Elder’s Sword Energy had been driving in without pause when it suddenly changed course. In the next instant, a strike like lightning split its target.
hunks.sol: The First Elder’s Sword Energy, which had been bearing down on him without pause, abruptly changed course. The next instant, a lightning-fast strike split its target.

hunks.baseline: A man staggered in a spray of blood. The sword that had been aimed at the First Elder’s side had shattered beyond recognition, and blood poured from his chest like a waterfall.
hunks.sol: A man staggered amid a spray of blood. The sword he had aimed at the First Elder’s side had shattered beyond recognition, and blood poured from his chest like a waterfall.

hunks.baseline: The First Elder confirmed his face and clicked his tongue.
hunks.sol: The First Elder saw his face and clicked his tongue.

hunks.baseline: The Discipline Hall Master’s voice sounded ready to break. He neither fell nor stopped talking.
hunks.sol: The Discipline Hall Master’s voice seemed ready to give out at any moment. Yet he neither fell nor stopped speaking.

hunks.baseline: “As the Discipline Hall Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I command you. The guilty shall abolish their own martial arts and enter the Cave of Repentance…”
hunks.sol: “As Discipline Hall Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I command you. The guilty shall abolish their own martial arts and enter the Cave of Repentance…”

hunks.baseline: The First Elder answered with his sword. The Discipline Hall Master’s nature was straight as a bamboo stalk, but his martial arts were not high. He could neither see nor dodge the stroke that pierced his throat.
hunks.sol: The First Elder answered with his sword. The Discipline Hall Master’s character was straight as bamboo, but his martial arts were not particularly advanced. He could neither see nor evade the stroke that pierced his throat.

hunks.baseline: Fire poured from Jin Wikyung’s eyes.
hunks.sol: Fire blazed in Jin Wikyung’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung was not the only one enraged. The Discipline Hall Master’s death set fire to the hearts of the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s senior members.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung was not the only one enraged. The Discipline Hall Master’s death set the hearts of the Jin Family’s senior members ablaze.

hunks.baseline: They had lived long enough to have much they had built, and much they had to protect. That was why they had feared it: a Peak master’s prowess, thrown away on a dog’s death.
hunks.sol: They had lived long enough to build much and gain much they needed to protect. That was why they had been afraid—afraid of a Peak master’s might, and of dying like dogs.

hunks.baseline: But the Discipline Hall Master’s dignified end brought the feelings they had set aside boiling back.
hunks.sol: But the Discipline Hall Master’s dignified end brought emotions they had briefly forgotten boiling back to the surface.

hunks.baseline: Shame, and anger.
hunks.sol: Shame and anger.

hunks.baseline: “Strike down those rebels!”
hunks.sol: “Strike down those traitors!”

hunks.baseline: The ones who felt ashamed of themselves were the first to charge. They were senior members of the so-called Elders’ faction.
hunks.sol: Those most ashamed of themselves were the first to charge. They were senior members of the so-called Elders’ faction.

hunks.baseline: They could not forgive themselves for aiding the traitors. Nor could they forgive the Elders who had betrayed them and the family.
hunks.sol: They could not forgive themselves for aiding the traitors, nor could they forgive the Elders who had betrayed them and their family.

hunks.baseline: Every time the three Elders’ swords flashed, another life went out.
hunks.sol: Each flash of the three Elders’ swords extinguished another life.

hunks.baseline: The gap in strength was obvious. Even so, the Elders’ wrinkled faces had gone stiff.
hunks.sol: The difference in strength was obvious. Even so, the Elders’ wrinkled faces stiffened.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of First Rate masters, resolved to take their enemies with them, came on from every side without fear of death.

hunks.baseline: What rattled the Elders was not their opponents’ martial arts, but their momentum.
hunks.sol: It was not their martial arts that rattled the Elders, but their momentum.

hunks.baseline: And in that gap, two men did not miss the opening.
hunks.sol: And amid that distraction, two men seized the opening.

hunks.baseline: A scream tore from the Third Elder’s mouth. Before he knew it, Wipeng’s Sword Energy had surged up and cut across his side.
hunks.sol: A scream tore from the Third Elder’s mouth. Wipeng’s Sword Energy had erupted without warning and sliced into his side.

hunks.baseline: The Second Elder wavered at the cry of the sworn brother he had spent decades with. For the briefest instant, his attention went elsewhere.
hunks.sol: The Second Elder faltered at the cry of the sworn brother who had been by his side for decades. For the briefest instant, his attention shifted elsewhere.

hunks.baseline: Three swords thrust out at once and skimmed his whole body. As the Second Elder scrambled back, a bolt of lightning shot toward him.
hunks.sol: Three swords thrust out at once, grazing him from head to toe. As the Second Elder scrambled backward, a bolt of lightning shot toward him.

hunks.baseline: The instant he felt something cold drive into his back, the Second Elder knew it was over.
hunks.sol: The instant he felt something cold burrow into his back, the Second Elder knew it was over.

hunks.baseline: It split flesh and severed bone. The Sword Energy ran wild like a living thing, tearing through his blood vessels and burning them.
hunks.sol: It split flesh and severed bone. Sword Energy rampaged like a living thing, tearing through his blood vessels and burning them.

hunks.baseline: The Second Elder’s vision went white. Soon he could not feel any pain at all.
hunks.sol: The Second Elder’s vision turned white. A moment later, he could no longer feel any pain at all.

hunks.baseline: As Jin Wikyung ripped his sword from the Second Elder’s chest and roared, the Third Elder’s head was falling not far away. Wipeng, soaked in blood, lifted it high.
hunks.sol: As Jin Wikyung tore his sword from the Second Elder’s chest and roared, the Third Elder’s head fell not far away. Wipeng, drenched in blood, raised it high.

hunks.baseline: The survivors shouted one after another.
hunks.sol: The survivors took up the cry.

hunks.baseline: “Wipe out the rebels!”
hunks.sol: “Wipe out the traitors!”

hunks.baseline: The cries ringing from every direction put strength into the Jin Family’s martial artists.
hunks.sol: The shouts ringing out across the battlefield invigorated the Jin Family’s martial artists.

hunks.baseline: Mount Heng’s command had been all but wiped out, and they still had not found their bearings. Before long, though, they turned their weapons on the black-clad men.
hunks.sol: With their leadership all but annihilated, Mount Heng’s forces still had no idea what to do. Before long, however, they turned their weapons on the black-clad men.

hunks.baseline: “Cut the stupid talk. The only ones coming at us are those black bastards!”
hunks.sol: “Enough of that nonsense. The only ones attacking us are those black-clad bastards!”

hunks.baseline: He was right. The Jin Family’s martial artists were following their command’s orders to the letter, and Mount Heng’s people realized one of their enemies had dropped away.
hunks.sol: He was right. The Jin Family’s martial artists followed their commanders’ orders to the letter, allowing Mount Heng’s people to realize that one of their enemies had fallen away.

hunks.baseline: The black-clad men who had appeared out of nowhere were now the common enemy.
hunks.sol: Now the black-clad men who had appeared out of nowhere were their common enemy.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know where you crawled out of, but we’ll wipe every last one of you out!”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know where you crawled out from, but wipe them all out!”

hunks.baseline: Once the two forces joined up, it was the black-clad men who started to give ground.
hunks.sol: Once the two forces joined together, the black-clad men began to give ground.

hunks.baseline: They were elites hardened by brutal training, but the deaths of the two Elders were bound to shake their morale. Blades crashed in from every direction, wasting no opening, and the black-clad men began to die one after another.
hunks.sol: They were elites hardened by brutal training, but the deaths of the two Elders inevitably shook their morale. Blades poured in from every direction, exploiting every opening, and the black-clad men began to fall one after another.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t fall back! Anyone who falls back dies!”
hunks.sol: “Do not retreat! Anyone who falls back will die!”

hunks.baseline: Even in that chaos, the First Elder swung his sword without a word.
hunks.sol: Even amid the chaos, the First Elder silently swung his sword.

hunks.baseline: Everything his eyes fell on, everything his hands reached toward, was an enemy.
hunks.sol: Everything within his sight, everything within his reach, was his enemy.

hunks.baseline: Twenty? Thirty? He didn’t know. Like a man possessed, the First Elder cut down everything in his way. Among them were people who had once called him Elder, and young men who looked barely twenty.
hunks.sol: Twenty? Thirty? He had lost count. Like a man possessed, the First Elder cut down everything in his path. Among his victims were men who had once addressed him with respect, as well as youths who looked barely twenty.

hunks.baseline: *What does age matter to living and dying? Anyone who stands at the point of a sword is a person of Murim.*
hunks.sol: *What does age matter in life or death? Those who stand at swordpoint are people of Murim.*

hunks.baseline: What blocked the First Elder, drenched in the blood of dozens, was a man built like a bear. His eyes looked ready to burn everything to ash.
hunks.sol: At last, a bear of a man blocked the path of the First Elder, who was drenched in the blood of dozens. His gaze seemed fierce enough to burn everything to ash.

hunks.baseline: “Wealth and glory. To take the Jin Family of Taiyuan and swallow Shanxi whole.”
hunks.sol: “Wealth and glory. To seize the Jin Family of Taiyuan and swallow Shanxi whole.”

hunks.baseline: The answer came without a hint of hesitation, and everyone trembled with rage.
hunks.sol: The answer came without a moment’s hesitation, making everyone tremble with rage.

hunks.baseline: Everyone except one. Jin Wikyung shook his head.
hunks.sol: Everyone but Jin Wikyung. He shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “Then you answer, Lesser Family Head. Why would I, my brothers, and our lord do a thing like this?”
hunks.sol: “Then you tell me, Lesser Family Head. Why would my brothers, my lord, and I do such a thing?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s quiet voice went on.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung continued in a low voice.

hunks.baseline: “The grand plan you talked about wasn’t for wealth and glory, or to become the ruler of a single province. Too many chances for that have already passed, and you’re all old. And…”
hunks.sol: “The grand plan you spoke of wasn’t for wealth and glory, or to become the ruler of a single province. Too many opportunities for that have already passed, and all of you are old. And…”

hunks.baseline: “The Head Elder has no descendants. Neither do the Second Elder, the Third Elder, or you.”
hunks.sol: “The Head Elder has no descendants. Neither did the Second Elder or the Third Elder. Nor do you.”

hunks.baseline: In that instant, a livid spark leapt from the First Elder’s still eyes.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a livid spark flared in the First Elder’s placid eyes.

hunks.baseline: It was anger he had held down for a very long time—dregs that rose for the briefest moment, then sank again.
hunks.sol: It was anger suppressed over long years, a remnant that surfaced for the briefest moment before sinking again.

hunks.baseline: No—the tip pointed past Jin Wikyung’s shoulder, toward someone who would be standing somewhere beyond him.
hunks.sol: No—the tip pointed past Jin Wikyung’s shoulder, toward someone somewhere beyond him.

hunks.baseline: In the end, the last key was in the Head Elder’s hands.
hunks.sol: In the end, the final key lay in the Head Elder’s hands.

hunks.baseline: “Well? Can you really afford to take it this easy?”
hunks.sol: “Are you sure you can afford to take your time like this?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s frown went rigid.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s frown froze.

hunks.baseline: His youngest brother, the apple of his eye, was standing in the Head Elder’s way.
hunks.sol: His precious youngest brother was holding off the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: The instant he remembered what he had let slip, it felt as if every drop of blood in him ran cold.
hunks.sol: The instant he remembered the fact that had briefly slipped his mind, his blood seemed to turn cold.

hunks.baseline: Once he grasped the whole situation, a voice like frost burst from Jin Wikyung’s mouth.
hunks.sol: Realizing the full situation, Jin Wikyung issued an icy command.

hunks.baseline: “Wipeng. Take the First Elder.”
hunks.sol: “Wipeng. Take care of the First Elder.”

hunks.sol: Wipeng and a dozen or so surviving senior members formed a wide ring around the First Elder.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone else, follow me and break through! We’re going after the Head Elder!”
hunks.sol: “Everyone else, follow me and open a path! We’re going after the Head Elder!”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung was about to move with several dozen guards when he glanced at the First Elder. Even with his end closing in, the man showed no agitation. If anything, he looked unburdened.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung was about to move out with several dozen guards when he glanced back at the First Elder. Though his end was approaching, the old man showed no agitation. If anything, he looked relieved.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung tossed out a single line.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung tossed out a single sentence.

hunks.baseline: “By the authority of the Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I expel you from the family.”
hunks.sol: “By the authority vested in me as Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I expel you from the family.”

hunks.sol: Leaving the First Elder’s laughter behind, Jin Wikyung sprinted across the battlefield.

hunks.sol: Dozens of black-clad men tried to stop him, but the battle had long since turned against them. Martial artists converged from every direction and hacked them to pieces.

hunks.baseline: “It’s the Lesser Family Head! Kill anyone who gets in his way!”
